title: Yoisaki Kanade — In The Dark〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You said they're around here, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Looks like they finally had a chance to talk.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But we should give them some space for now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: MEIKO, would you mind being with them for a little while longer?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Miku and the others are probably worried, so we can go over to SEKAI to tell them what's happening. We'll be waiting for you over there.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They'll be here in a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's been so long since we last saw Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah...
So, um... What are we allowed to say?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
About that...
First, I'd like for us to hear what Mizuki has to say.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I have a feeling it's very important.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There's something I need to tell all of you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Something you guys have to hear...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Something I've been wanting to say.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm sorry for not telling you guys until now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I should've done this sooner. I was meaning to...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I agree. It's also our fault for not realizing how much this was weighing on you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, it's all my fault for not saying anything...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No matter what happens, in our eyes, you're you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, thank you for being so brave.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And thank you for telling us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm also glad that you told us.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
See?
Didn't I say that it'd all work out in the end?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Again, it's wonderful to have you back with us like this.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And don't hesitate to ask us for help in the future if you ever need it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're a valued member of N25.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So if something is causing you trouble or to suffer, then we want to be there for you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because it hurts us too when it feels like there's nothing we can do.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, please don't be afraid to tell us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I look forward to having you around again.
